column2: Vertical travel photograph, portrait 2:3, shot on 35mm film look. A quiet narrow street in the Marrakech medina in early morning golden light: warm terracotta and ochre plastered walls, a tall carved cedar wooden door under a horseshoe arch, a few green zellige tiles at the base of the wall, a potted olive tree, soft diagonal sunlight and long shadows on the ground, a sliver of deep blue sky at the top. The upper third of the frame is calm wall and sky with little detail, so text can be placed there later. Natural colours, subtle film grain, slightly muted contrast, authentic and calm, editorial travel photography. No people, no animals, no text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermarks.
